fiche: Petite flamme de lumière pure qui flotte au-dessus des sanctuaires oubliés et des sommets nocturnes.
apparence: Floating teardrop-shaped spirit made of soft glowing light with a white-gold core; colors white, pale gold, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A round glowing white orb with big sky-blue eyes and a tiny gold flicker on top.
stades.enfant: The orb stretches into a teardrop and grows two tiny stubby light-arms and a small gold ring circling its head.
stades.ado: The body becomes a tall candle-flame shape with longer arms, a wispy flowing tail and two orbiting silver sparks.
stades.adulte: A tall radiant flame-spirit with long graceful arms, a crown of three gold flames and a ring of orbiting silver stars.
stades.ancien: A wide calm flame-spirit with a long white wispy beard of light, a cracked gold halo and a small floating silver lantern.

fiche: Lapin constellé qui bondit dans les prairies au clair de lune en semant des étincelles d'étoiles.
apparence: Small rabbit with dark-blue velvety fur speckled with glowing star dots linked by thin silver lines; colors midnight blue, silver, white.

stades.bebe: A round fluffy midnight-blue bunny ball with huge silver eyes, tiny ears and three white star freckles.
stades.enfant: Long ears grow with glowing star tips, small legs appear and the star freckles connect into a little silver constellation on its back.
stades.ado: The body becomes lean and leggy, the ears stretch into crescent shapes and a fluffy comet-like white tail appears.
stades.adulte: A graceful hare with long crescent-moon ears, a full glowing constellation pattern over the body and silver star-shaped hind paws.
stades.ancien: An elder hare with drooping crescent ears, a long white silky beard, faded constellation spots and a tiny floating silver moon above its head.

fiche: Oisillon ailé aux plumes d'or qui veille sur les clochers en ruine et les nids des falaises.
apparence: Small angelic bird with white feathers, gold-tipped wings and a tiny halo; colors white, gold, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A round white fluffy chick with big blue eyes, a tiny gold beak and two little stubby wings.
stades.enfant: Wings lengthen with gold tips, a small thin gold halo appears above the head and a short fan tail grows.
stades.ado: The bird gets a slender neck, a second smaller pair of wings near the tail and long sky-blue crest feathers.
stades.adulte: A noble four-winged bird with a gleaming gold halo, long sweeping white-and-gold tail plumes and armored gold talons.
stades.ancien: An elder four-winged bird with a fluffy white feather beard, a cracked ancient halo and frayed silver-tipped wings.

fiche: Petit nuage de poussière d'étoiles vivant qui dérive dans le ciel nocturne et les grottes de cristal.
apparence: Soft amorphous blob of swirling nebula gas with embedded tiny stars; colors lavender-blue, white, silver.

stades.bebe: A small round puff of pale blue mist with two big shiny eyes and a few sparkling specks inside.
stades.enfant: The puff grows little drooping mist-tendrils underneath and a swirling spiral pattern appears in its body.
stades.ado: The body spreads into a wider cloud shape with a bright star core visible in the chest and drifting silver star particles.
stades.adulte: A large swirling nebula mass with several glowing star cores, long trailing mist-arms and a ring of orbiting silver dust.
stades.ancien: An elder nebula blob, darker and denser, with a long drooping mist beard and tiny ancient planets circling it.

fiche: Serpent céleste dont la queue laisse une traînée lumineuse comme une comète au-dessus des déserts nocturnes.
apparence: Long slender serpent with an icy white head and a glowing trailing comet tail; colors white, icy blue, gold.

stades.bebe: A tiny round white head with big blue eyes and a short glowing stubby tail like a little spark.
stades.enfant: The body lengthens into a short worm shape, the tail becomes a wispy gold trail and two small fin-ridges appear on the head.
stades.ado: The serpent stretches long and coiled, grows a crest of icy crystal spikes and the tail splits into three glowing streamers.
stades.adulte: A long majestic sky-serpent with a crystal-crowned head, a blazing gold-and-blue comet tail and silver scales along its spine.
stades.ancien: An elder sky-serpent with chipped crystal crest, long white whiskers, faded tail streamers and small orbiting rock fragments.

fiche: Petit moine de lumière à auréole qui garde les temples des montagnes et allume les lanternes à l'aube.
apparence: Small round humanoid in a hooded white robe with a gold halo and a glowing face; colors white, gold, silver.

stades.bebe: A round white blob with stubby feet, huge gold eyes and a tiny wobbly halo.
stades.enfant: Tiny arms appear holding a little silver bell and the body gains a small hood over the head.
stades.ado: Taller with a full white robe, sleeves with gold trim, a wider halo and a short silver staff.
stades.adulte: A dignified robed guardian with a large radiant double halo, glowing hands and a tall silver staff topped with a sun disc.
stades.ancien: An elder robed monk with a long white beard, cracked halo, hunched shoulders and a twisted silver cane with hanging bells.

fiche: Chèvre sacrée aux cornes en croissant de lune qui escalade les pics enneigés les nuits de pleine lune.
apparence: Mountain goat with silver-white fur and moon-crescent horns that glow; colors silver, pale blue, white.

stades.bebe: A round fluffy white kid with big silver eyes, tiny hooves and two small nub horns.
stades.enfant: Small crescent-shaped horns grow, the legs lengthen and a pale blue moon spot appears on its forehead.
stades.ado: The horns curve into wide glowing crescents, a long shaggy mane grows and silver hooves become hard and shiny.
stades.adulte: A powerful mountain goat with huge double crescent horns, a glowing full-moon disc on its chest and flowing silver mane.
stades.ancien: An elder goat with a long braided white beard, cracked mossy horns with tiny hanging star charms and a faint lunar halo.

fiche: Long mille-pattes de lumière dont chaque segment brille comme une étoile, il serpente dans les grottes de cristal.
apparence: Long segmented centipede made of translucent glowing star-orbs joined by silver rings; colors silver, white, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A short chain of three round glowing white orbs with a cute face on the first and tiny nub legs.
stades.enfant: Two more orb segments appear, each with pairs of thin silver legs, and short antennae with star tips grow.
stades.ado: The body becomes long with many segments, the legs sharpen into silver needles and the head gains crescent mandibles.
stades.adulte: A long radiant centipede with dozens of star-orb segments, gold-plated head armor and glowing crescent mandibles.
stades.ancien: An elder centipede with dimmed cracked segments, crystal growths along its back and long drooping white antenna-whiskers.

fiche: Hibou à six ailes qui veille la nuit sur les tours célestes et lit les étoiles.
apparence: Owl with six white wings, gold eye markings and a silver feather crest; colors white, gold, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A round white owlet puff with enormous gold eyes and two tiny wings.
stades.enfant: A second pair of small wings sprouts and gold eye-ring markings appear around its eyes.
stades.ado: A third pair of wings grows, the body slims, silver ear-tufts become long crest feathers.
stades.adulte: A majestic six-winged owl with gold-edged feathers, eye-shaped patterns on every wing and gleaming silver talons.
stades.ancien: An elder six-winged owl with tiny round spectacles of crystal, a white feather beard and a floating open star-map scroll.

fiche: Masque flottant mi-soleil mi-lune qui n'apparaît que pendant les éclipses au-dessus des ruines.
apparence: Floating round mask split half gold sun, half silver moon, with a flowing light cape; colors gold, silver, deep blue.

stades.bebe: A small round disc face, half gold and half silver, with two big blinking eyes.
stades.enfant: A thin ring of light appears around the disc and two small floating gloved hands materialize beside it.
stades.ado: The disc gains a pointed sun-ray crown on the gold side and a crescent horn on the silver side, plus a short deep blue cape.
stades.adulte: A large floating eclipse mask with a blazing corona of rays, long flowing deep blue cape and four floating hands holding orbs.
stades.ancien: An elder eclipse mask with cracked weathered face, a corona of faded rays and tattered cape decorated with old silver runes.

fiche: Lion sacré à crinière de flammes dorées, gardien des temples solaires du désert.
apparence: Large lion with white fur and a radiant golden sun-ray mane; colors white, gold, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A round white cub with big blue eyes and a small fluffy gold tuft of mane.
stades.enfant: The legs grow sturdy, the mane tuft spreads into short pointed gold rays and a gold sun mark appears on the forehead.
stades.ado: The body becomes lean and muscular, the mane forms a full ring of rays and gold armor bands appear on its forelegs.
stades.adulte: A mighty lion with a blazing circular sun-ray mane, gold armored shoulders and a tail ending in a small sun orb.
stades.ancien: An elder lion with a thick white flowing mane-beard, chipped gold armor, and a faint glowing halo of rays behind its head.

fiche: Chevalier de lumière qui manie une lame forgée dans une étoile, il garde les portes du ciel.
apparence: Humanoid knight of light with silver armor and a glowing star blade; colors silver, white, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A small round silver helmet with big glowing blue eyes in the visor and tiny stubby legs.
stades.enfant: Short arms appear, one holding a tiny star-shaped dagger, and a small white cape grows on its back.
stades.ado: Taller and slim, with full silver armor plates, a sword of light and two small feather wings on the helmet.
stades.adulte: A towering armored knight with a long radiant star blade, a shield shaped like a constellation and luminous wing-shaped pauldrons.
stades.ancien: An elder knight with weathered dented armor, a long white beard flowing out of the helmet and a cracked star blade used as a cane.

fiche: Grand serpent ailé des hautes altitudes qui ondule entre les aurores boréales.
apparence: Long feathered sky serpent with pale blue scales, white feather fins and an aurora-colored crest; colors sky blue, white, silver.

stades.bebe: A round sky-blue hatchling coil with big eyes and two tiny feather tufts on the head.
stades.enfant: The body lengthens and small white feather fins grow along its sides.
stades.ado: Two pairs of feathered wings appear along the long body and a shimmering aurora crest grows on the head.
stades.adulte: A colossal winged serpent with four feathered wings, a long rippling aurora crest and silver star scales along its belly.
stades.ancien: An elder winged serpent with long white whiskers, frayed old wings, and tiny floating ice crystals drifting around it.

fiche: Tortue cosmique colossale qui porte une galaxie sur sa carapace et dort sur les rives des lacs gelés.
apparence: Huge turtle with a dark-blue domed shell containing a swirling starry galaxy; colors deep blue, silver, gold.

stades.bebe: A tiny round turtle with a soft blue shell holding a single sparkling star and big sleepy eyes.
stades.enfant: The shell hardens and a small spiral of stars appears inside it, and gold claw tips grow on its stubby legs.
stades.ado: The shell grows tall and domed with a crystal rim, showing a small swirling galaxy and orbiting moonlets.
stades.adulte: A colossal turtle carrying a vast glowing galaxy dome on its back, silver-plated legs and a gold crown-like head crest.
stades.ancien: An elder turtle with a mossy cracked crystal shell, a long white chin beard and tiny planets orbiting its head.

fiche: Reine céleste aux ailes immenses qui règne sur le firmament et fait se lever les étoiles.
apparence: Regal winged deer-like celestial being with white fur, gold antlers shaped like a crown and starry wings; colors white, gold, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A small round white fawn with big gold eyes, a tiny star on its forehead and two little feather wings.
stades.enfant: Tiny gold antler buds grow, the wings become longer with sky-blue tips and small star spots appear on its back.
stades.ado: The deer grows long legs, branching gold antlers forming a crown and a second pair of wings appears.
stades.adulte: A colossal regal winged deer with a gold crown of antlers, four vast wings full of constellations and a radiant halo.
stades.ancien: An ancient queen deer with antlers draped in silver chains and relics, a long white mane-beard and wings scattered with glowing old stars.
